products.descriptionMd:

products.name: Bead strand kit

Everything you need to string one bracelet or bag strap in an evening. The pastel mix has glossy pink, teal, yellow, purple and orange acrylic beads, and neon and earth mixes are also available. Thread them in any order, tie off with a clasp and wear it or clip it on a bag.
